test_title: PYST 41: SSC MTS - Reasoning (Held on: 7 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the Venn diagram the best illustrates the relationship between the following classes.

Females, Mothers, Sisters
solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for given relation is as shown below :

 
• All Mothers are Females.
 
• All Sisters are Females.
 
• Some Mothers can be Sisters and vice-versa.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/10cc02b8dea55ab7440ea778c1a4f1072ab373ae94341ea9683aa32a870e3576.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
